stages.description: Stages in flight order (first stage first)

description: A vehicle and the flight to simulate
title: OpenTsiolkovsky configuration

end_time_s.description: Simulation end time from launch [s]; the flight also ends at ground impact

step_s.description: Step size [s] (default: half the output step)

oneOf.description:
Classic Runge-Kutta, fixed step; intervals are split evenly so the
steps end exactly on events and output times

abs_tol.description: Absolute tolerance (all state components: kg, m, m/s)

Integrator.description: Integration method of the equations of motion

time_utc.description:
Launch time, ISO 8601 (`2024-07-01T01:00:00Z`; an offset such as
`+09:00` is converted to UTC)

velocity_ned_mps.description:
Initial Earth-relative velocity: north, east, down [m/s]. At rest the
vehicle is held on the pad until the thrust lifts it; otherwise (air
launch, restart in flight) it flies free from the start

rail_length_m.description: Launcher rail length along the initial attitude [m]; 0: pad only

UtcTime.description: ISO 8601 date-time; without an offset it is UTC

seasonal_variation_percent.description:
Seasonal density variation [%] (-100 to 100), applied along the
U.S. Standard Atmosphere variation profile (the sign flips between
low and high altitude)

density_deviation.description:
Density deviation [%] over altitude [m], rows `[altitude_m, percent]`;
replaces the seasonal variation

oneOf.description:
U.S. Standard Atmosphere 1976: layers in geopotential altitude
up to 86 km, tabulated values (log-linear) from 86 to 1000 km

As the C++ simulator: the 1976 layers evaluated at the geometric
altitude, isothermal (186.95 K) above 84.852 km

columns.description: Columns to read, 0-based (default: the first ones)

Table.description: Rows given inline or read from a CSV file

direction_deg.description: Direction the constant wind blows from, clockwise from north [deg]

profile.description:
Wind over altitude, rows `[altitude_m, speed_mps, direction_deg]`,
interpolated in north/east components; replaces the constant wind

columns.description: Columns to read, 0-based (default: the first ones)

Table2.description: Rows given inline or read from a CSV file

azimuth_deg.description: Azimuth of the body axis, clockwise from north [deg]

elevation_deg.description: Elevation of the body axis above the horizon [deg] (90: vertical)

yaw_offset_deg.description: Body misalignment from the program, applied about Z, then Y, then X [deg]

gyro_bias_deg_h.description: Gyro bias about body X, Y, Z [deg/h]: the attitude drifts linearly from launch

Attitude.description: Attitude program of the vehicle (time from launch)

Curve.description: Constant or a table of `[x, y]` rows (piecewise linear, clamped at the ends)

mass_initial_kg.description: Initial mass of this stage alone, without the upper stages [kg]

mass_dry_kg.description:
Mass without propellant [kg]; the burn ends when the propellant
(initial minus dry mass) runs out. Unset: the whole stage may burn

separation_time_s.description:
Separation of the upper stages, from this stage's start [s]; required
for every stage but the last

jettisons.description: Bodies released during this stage's flight (fairings, ...)

thrust_trim.description: Gimbal the thrust to balance the aerodynamic moment

isp_vac_s.description: Vacuum specific impulse over stage time [s]

burn_end_s.description: End of the burn, from the stage start [s]

nozzle_exit_area_m2.description: Nozzle exit area [m²], for the ambient pressure loss

Engine.description:
Rocket engine of a stage. Thrust = vacuum thrust - exit area x ambient
pressure (never negative); mass flow = vacuum thrust / (vacuum Isp x g0)

diameter_m.description: Reference diameter [m]; reference area = pi/4 x diameter²

ca_power_off.description:
Axial force coefficient over Mach while the engine is off (base
drag); unset: `ca`

cn_alpha_per_rad.description:
Normal force slope CN-alpha over Mach [1/rad]; normal force =
CN-alpha x angle of attack [rad] x dynamic pressure x reference area

cn_table.description:
Normal force coefficient over Mach x angle of attack; replaces
`cn_alpha_per_rad`

ballistic_coefficient_kg_m2.description:
Ballistic coefficient for `free_flight: "ballistic"` [kg/m²]
(drag deceleration = dynamic pressure / coefficient)

Aero.description: Aerodynamics of a stage (and everything above it)

alpha_deg.description: Angles of attack [deg] (ascending, 0 to 90, or 180 for flow from behind)

anyOf.description: CSV file: first row `-, alpha_1, alpha_2, ...`, then `mach, value_1, value_2, ...`

Surface.description: Values over Mach number x angle of attack [deg]

oneOf.description: Body aligned with the airflow: axial force only
Body follows the attitude program (axial and normal force)

FreeFlight.description: Motion of a stage while its engine is off

time_s.description: Release time from the stage start [s]; must be before the separation

mass_kg.description: Mass, part of the stage's dry mass [kg]

ballistic_coefficient_kg_m2.description: Ballistic coefficient of the released body [kg/m²]

delta_v_ned_mps.description: Velocity added at release: north, east, down [m/s]

Jettison.description: A body released from a stage

cg_sta_m.description: Centre of gravity STA over stage time [m]

gimbal_sta_m.description: Gimbal (thrust point) STA over stage time [m]

cp_sta_m.description: Centre of pressure STA over Mach x angle of attack [m]

ThrustTrim.description:
Thrust direction that balances the aerodynamic moment about the CG
(the C++ simulator's 3DoF "neutrality"). Positions are STA [m]: distance
aft of the nose. Offsets move the CG, centre of pressure and thrust
point in body axes (X forward) [m].
